journey.name: Jade Locked On Device
journey.description: Logs the paired Jade out on the device itself and checks the message the app shows when it next needs the Jade. Requires `JADE_MODE=interactive ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and no Jade paired. For the send steps, Settings, Advanced, Electrum Server must point at the `bitkit-docker` Electrum. Each log-out happens while the app holds an open Jade session: closing Receive after Verify on Device ends the session, and so does leaving Send without a sent payment, so the journey funds from the address Receive shows, signs first and verifies last. The device answers the next request with HW_LOCKED, and the app asks for the PIN on the device again and retries, on Sign With Jade and on Verify on Device.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu"), tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), tap "Hardware Wallets" (testTag "HardwareWalletsSettings") and tap "Add Hardware Wallet" (testTag "AddHardwareWallet")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "HardwareWalletIntroContinue") and verify the "Found Device" step (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundScreen") headed "Found Jade" appears within 15 seconds

Tap "Connect" (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundConnect"), run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345` in `bitkit-docker`, verify the "Device Connected" step (testTag "HardwareWalletPairedScreen") appears within 30 seconds and tap "Finish" (testTag "HardwareWalletPairedFinish")

Tap Receive (testTag "Receive"), select the Jade tab, tap "Show Details" if the address is hidden behind it, read the address without tapping "Verify on Device", close the receive sheet and fund it: `./bitcoin-cli sendtoaddress JADE_ADDRESS 0.001; ./bitcoin-cli -generate 1` in `bitkit-docker`. Wait for the "Received Bitcoin" sheet and tap its button (testTag "ReceivedTransactionButton")
Run `./scripts/jade-emulator press front right front` in `bitkit-docker` to choose Session, then Log Out, on the device

Tap Send (testTag "Send"), enter a regtest address of the bitkit-docker node manually, select the Jade as the funding source on the amount screen (testTag "AssetButton-switch"), enter 50 000 sats, tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount"), swipe to confirm and tap "Sign With Jade" (testTag "HardwareSendOpenTrezorConnect")
Verify the Jade shows its PIN pad, then run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345`

Run `./scripts/jade-emulator press front` to pass the Output screen, then `./scripts/jade-emulator press right front` to sign on Send Transaction, and verify the success screen (testTag "SendSuccess") headed "Bitcoin Sent" appears within 30 seconds, with one payment sent
Close the success screen and run `./scripts/jade-emulator press front right front` to log out on the device again
Tap Receive, select the Jade tab, tap "Show Details" if needed, then tap "Verify on Device" (testTag "HardwareVerifyAddress") and verify the Jade shows its PIN pad again
Run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345`, then `./scripts/jade-emulator press right front` once the device shows Verify Address, and verify the button returns to "Verify on Device" with no error
